newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo U.S. Treasury market closed for Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo U.S. Treasury market closed for Thanksgiving.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury market is closed in Tokyo on Thursday for the Thanksgiving holiday.
The market will resume on Friday, traders said. Trading will be abbreviated in New York on Friday, when the market will close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT.
Treasuries prices ended mostly higher in New York on Wednesday, with the key 6-1/2 percent 30-year benchmark bond up 6/32 at 100-31/32, yielding 6.43 percent.
